correctness.rationale: For equal-length binary halves, matching all scattered subsequence counts of lengths 1 and 2 is equivalent exactly to matching zero count and scattered 01 pair count. On adjoining a letter, the only new 2-binomial square factors are suffixes ending at that letter. The prefix-monotone condition permits exhaustive binary branching with pruning upon the fourth distinct literal square, and exhaustiveness follows inductively. A fresh independent Python implementation reconstructed full BFS layers without relying on source output, obtaining numbers n=40..44 of 64,32,16,4,0 and exactly the four stated 43-character witnesses. Thus the finite search is exhaustive (not a nonexhaustive experiment) and proves the unbounded upper bound via forbidden length-44 prefixes. Source BFS and direct six-coordinate DFS implementations were separately read. Exact classification concerns distinct literal contiguous factors, not equivalence classes or occurrences.
